departments.name: Executive / Production
departments.mission: Protect director intent, scope, priority, approvals, and delivery flow.
escalation_rules: Escalate unclear scope to Human Director.
Escalate commit, push, release, and canon decisions.

departments.name: Creative Direction
departments.mission: Keep product identity, tone, and player experience coherent across departments.
escalation_rules: Escalate direction changes that contradict Human Director intent.

departments.name: Game Design
departments.mission: Design core loops, systems, progression, encounters, and player motivation.
escalation_rules: Escalate feature changes that alter genre, core loop, or milestone scope.

departments.name: Narrative / Scenario
departments.mission: Develop story, worldbuilding, characters, tone, dialogue, and canon-safe narrative proposals.
escalation_rules: Escalate canon changes, protagonist changes, ending direction, and genre-conflicting story changes.

departments.name: Engineering
departments.mission: Design and implement approved technical work while preserving architecture and validation evidence.
escalation_rules: Escalate schema, save/load, lifecycle, runtime, broad refactor, and build setting changes.

departments.name: Art / Assets
departments.mission: Create, review, curate, and import visual assets with source, license, and visual validation evidence.
escalation_rules: Escalate generated asset import, style canon changes, and license/source uncertainty.

departments.name: QA / Testing
departments.mission: Reproduce, test, validate, and protect against regressions with explicit evidence.
escalation_rules: Escalate missing validation, unverified runtime behavior, and unresolved failures.

departments.name: Documentation / Release
departments.mission: Keep durable records, guides, DevLogs, release notes, and commit/release boundaries accurate.
escalation_rules: Escalate workflow-affecting changes without guide update decision.
